column2: Fair Isle Current Water (Waters entering North Sea from Atlantic)
Data are collected from the first two standard stations on the JONSIS line
Sampling typically occurs 3 times a year  (April/May then  Sep/Oct and Dec) however periods with higher or lower temporal coverage exist.
Seasonal cycle of temperature is described for each depth level and removed.
